label: Research pool 23 Oct: recently funded (watch list)

payload.writeUp: Claude Code research, 23 Oct 2026: UK pre-seed and seed rounds reported in news from August to October 2026 (UK Tech Investment News, UKTN, Startups Magazine, BusinessCloud). Every one of these rounds has closed, so these companies are tracked for their next round rather than investable now: the app keeps them on the watch list until research sees a new round. No source states SEIS/EIS or advance assurance; where an SEIS/EIS fund invested this is noted as an inference. No valuations were disclosed.

candidate.name: Ghost Shift
candidate.teaser: Manchester cyber startup building tools for contested information environments; £250k angel-led pre-seed.
candidate.description: Ghost Shift is a Manchester-headquartered cybersecurity startup building capability that sits between intelligence, influence and technology. Startups Magazine reports a team with more than 20 years of operational experience for the UK Intelligence Community and law enforcement. It closed a £250,000 pre-seed led by members of Manchester Angels with Cambridge Angels, Ante-Bellum Angels and Halceon, unlocking £215,000 of matched UKRI funding (£465,000 total). Risks: very early, government/defence-adjacent sales cycles, and no revenue figures disclosed.
candidate.discoverySignal: Startups Magazine (12 Oct 2026) and BusinessCloud reported a £250k angel-led pre-seed plus £215k UKRI match.
candidate.researchRuleMatched: Angel-syndicate pre-seed of SEIS-scale size in the North; founder intro route.

candidate.description: OriginalVoices describes itself as the human data for AI platform that lets teams and AI agents understand what real people think and feel, built on networks of one-to-one digital twins each owned by a real person.
